name: water-tenure-skills
description: Agent Skills for water tenure analysis on the FAO typology: source-cited tenure catalogues from field and desk evidence, exhaustive desk assessments with hyperresearch, recent-media scans, long-form reports by tenure type with OSCOLA or APA footnotes, and publication to a tenure map.
